Best, Sven

aiAgent.botConfirm: From now on the appointment bot AUTOMATICALLY chats with real customers via WhatsApp, proposes times and books them in your calendar — on no-show, first contact and deck view. aiAgent.botOnDesc: ARMED: on no-show, first contact and deck view the bot messages the customer on WhatsApp, proposes 2 free slots (German time), understands the reply, checks your calendar and books — incl. confirmation. Asks Zoom or WhatsApp call.

sim.taxHintCyPrivat: Cyprus, held privately: first €22,000 tax free, then 20/25/30/35 % (35 % only above €72,001). Deductible: 20 % flat deduction on gross rent, 3 % building depreciation p.a. (on 80 % of the price), 10 % on furniture and the loan interest. SDC on rents was abolished on 1 Jan 2026; GHS of 2.65 % remains (capped at €180,000).
sim.taxHintDePrivat: Tax residence Germany: Cyprus taxes first (€22,000 free, then 20-35 %, after the 20 % flat deduction, 3 % building depreciation and interest), Germany recalculates with its own depreciation and credits the Cypriot tax (double tax treaty, Art. 22). No GHS applies.
sim.taxHintFirma: Cyprus Ltd: no tax-free band and no 20 % flat deduction - only actual costs (management, interest, 3 % building depreciation, 10 % furniture). 15 % corporate tax since 1 Jan 2026, losses carried forward 5 years. Cyprus withholds nothing on distributions; a German shareholder pays 26.375 % (flat tax plus solidarity surcharge), a Cypriot non-dom only 2.65 % GHS.
sim.engineNote2: Calculated with the same engine as the individual calculations: annuity loan from handover, rent and taxes according to the structure selected above from handover, VAT refund for short-term letting after 24 months. Purchase instalments before handover come out of equity. You create the individual calculations for the client as usual via the "With yield calculation" checkbox - same numbers, same engine.
sim.engineNote3: Calculated with the engine of the single calculations: annuity loan from handover, rent and taxes according to the structure selected above from handover, VAT refund for short-term letting 18 months after handover. Purchase instalments follow the developer’s payment plan: first from equity; with instalments after handover, rent and the VAT refund contribute and the bank finances the rest. You create the single calculations for the client as usual via the "With yield calculation" option - same figures, same engine.
sim.maint: Maintenance reserve % p.a. of the purchase price
sim.costHint: The reserve is calculated on the original purchase price, not on the increased market value. Service charges apply per apartment and can be overridden per apartment below; both rise by 2 % per year.
sim.taxJoint: Tax is calculated across ALL apartments together: the tax-free band, the progression, existing income, the GHS cap and the company's loss carry-forward apply per client, not per apartment. An individual calculation for a single apartment therefore shows a different tax figure than this plan - and rightly so, because one apartment alone really is taxed differently than three together.
sim.exitHint2: The period ends in the year of sale. Agent and lawyer fees carry 19 % VAT, plus a 0.4 % transfer levy. Apartments not yet handed over at the time of sale are assigned at the amount paid in.
sim.irrHint: on the actual cash flows, p.a.
sim.beCalc: What appreciation does the strategy need at minimum?
sim.exHint: Taxable gain after Cypriot indexation: {{g}}. The lifetime allowance of €30,000 per person is applied once, not per apartment.
sim.taxHintCyPrivat2: Cyprus, held privately: first €22,000 tax free, then 20/25/30/35 % (35 % only above €72,001). Deductible: actual costs for short-term letting, a 20 % flat deduction for long-term letting, plus 3 % building depreciation p.a. (on 80 % of the price), 10 % on furniture and the loan interest. SDC on rents was abolished on 1 Jan 2026. Anyone letting short-term counts as self-employed: 16.6 % social insurance on at least €20,318 of notional income (capped at €68,904) and GHS at 4 % of profit instead of 2.65 % of rent.
sim.taxHintDePrivat2: Tax residence Germany: Cyprus taxes first, Germany recalculates with its own depreciation and credits the Cypriot tax (double tax treaty Art. 22, credit only, no exemption). The total burden is the Cypriot tax plus the German remainder that is not credited. No GHS and no social insurance apply.

qualitaet.erklaer1: An AE measures what a lead is worth, in booked appointments. Every lead counts with the value of its furthest step. A held appointment therefore counts more than a lead that only filled in the form, and a thumbs up counts most.
qualitaet.erklaer2: Cost per AE = spend divided by AE. Target: {{ziel}}. With little data the estimate is pulled towards the next higher level (ad, creative, ad set, campaign, account), so a range is shown next to it in which the true value lies with 80 % probability.
qualitaet.erklaer3: Chance good = probability that the cost per AE is below the target. Risk bad = probability that it is above twice the target. Attribution = share of leads matched to an ad; below 80 % the autopilot switches nothing off on its own.

help.ad_creative_features: Meta's automatic enhancements (AI image edits, text variations, overlays). All off by default at Happy Property: photos stay real, texts stay ours.
help.ad_multi_advertiser: On: the ad may be shown together with ads from other advertisers, including competitors. Off by default.
help.ad_url_tags: Fixed UTM standard appended to every link: campaign, ad set and ad as IDs. Not editable.
help.adset_advantage_audience: On: Meta may deliver beyond the audience; age and interests become suggestions. Under Housing the value must be set explicitly.
help.adset_attribution: Window in which a conversion is credited to the ad. Selectable for website conversions only, otherwise fixed to 1-day click.
help.adset_dsa: EU mandatory disclosure (Digital Services Act): who benefits from the ad and who pays for it. Default from the ad account.
help.adset_pixel: Meta optimizes for the event of this pixel. Landing pages and /termin only fire the HP pixel 1083578343946189.
help.adset_placements: Advantage+ placements let Meta use all placements (recommended). Manual only when specific placements must be excluded.
help.campaign_budget_level: On: Meta distributes one campaign budget across the ad sets. Off: every ad set has its own budget, like Plan B.
help.campaign_budget_sharing: Lets Meta move up to 20 % of the budget between ad sets. Daily budgets and the same bid strategy only; can only be switched off later.
help.status: Active means Meta delivers, as long as the campaign and ad set are active too. Pausing stops immediately, nothing is ever deleted.
help.budget_schedule: Raises the daily budget for a high-demand period (at least 3 hours), then the normal budget applies again.
help.adset_schedule: Show ads only on certain days and hours (full hours). Only with a lifetime budget.
help.adset_spend_limits: With campaign budget: how much this ad set should get at least or spend at most. Meta treats this as an average, not a hard limit.
help.ad_tracking: Which additional events Meta measures for this ad (website, app or CRM events). The ad set's pixel is tracked automatically.
help.adset_whatsapp: The WhatsApp number linked to the Facebook page, in the format +49 ... Leave empty to use the page's number.
help.ad_setup: Create a new ad with your own texts and media, or use an already published post as the ad (likes and comments stay).
help.ad_beitrag: The post is promoted as it is. Texts and images are edited in the post itself, not here.
help.ad_destination_kind: Where the click leads. The ad set's conversion location decides what is possible.
help.ad_telefon: Number that is called on click, in international format, for example +49 30 1234567.
help.ad_whatsapp_begruessung: First message the person sees in Happy Property's WhatsApp chat. Empty means Meta's default English text.
help.ad_whatsapp_nachricht: Text already in the person's input field, for example „I would like to know more about Cyprus“.
help.ad_landscape: Optional for right column, search and in-stream videos. Without landscape media Meta shows the feed media there.
help.ad_crops: Crop one photo for several formats (1:1, 4:5, 9:16, 1.91:1). Keep the important part in the middle.
help.ad_thumbnail: The image shown before playback. Pick one of Meta's suggestions or upload your own image.
help.ad_untertitel: Captions as an SRT file per language. Most people watch without sound; captions keep them watching.
help.ad_karussell_endkarte: Shows a final card with logo and link. Off at Happy Property so the last card is a property.
help.ad_karussell_reihenfolge: On: Meta shows the best performing cards first. Off: fixed order, for example to tell a story.
help.ad_sprachen: Also show the ad in English, for example for expats. Meta picks the right language per person; German stays the default.
help.ad_partnerschaft: Show the ad together with a partner, for example a creator. The partner has to approve this at Meta first.
help.ad_tracking_pixel: Additional pixels that also count this ad's conversions. The ad set's pixel always counts automatically.
help.ad_tracking_lead_qualitaet: Tells Meta which instant form leads were good in the CRM (conversion leads), so Meta learns to find better leads.
help.ad_conversion_domain: Domain where conversions happen, for example happy-property.com. Empty means: taken from the website URL. Without a website URL (Facebook post, WhatsApp, call, Messenger, instant form) it is required as soon as the ad shares data with a pixel.

housing.genders: Under Housing all genders are always reached.
housing.geo: Under Housing postcodes and small areas (neighbourhoods, districts) are not allowed.
housing.lookalike: Under Housing lookalike audiences are not allowed; custom audiences only if Meta marks them eligible.
housing.radius: Under Housing the radius is at least 15 km around addresses and places and at least 17 km around cities.

grund.abTest: A/B tests come in a later expansion. Until then use Meta Ads Manager.

grund.ausgabenlimits: Only with Advantage+ campaign budget. Here the ad set has its own budget.
grund.buchungsart: Reservation only exists for awareness and engagement. Leads always use auction.
grund.budgetplanungCbo: With a campaign budget, budget scheduling is set in the campaign.
grund.budgetplanungTag: Only possible with a daily budget.
grund.geraete: Devices can only be narrowed with manual placements.

grund.nachAnlegenGruppe: Only available after creation: create the ad set at Meta, then use “Edit”.

grund.wohnen: Not allowed by Meta under the housing special category.

bearbeiten.gruppeHinweis: Live ad set (ID {{id}}). Changes to audience, placements, performance goal, conversion event or bid restart the learning phase.

hilfe.abrechnung: What Meta charges for. Impressions is the default.
hilfe.abrechnungFest: With this performance goal Meta always charges per impression.
hilfe.andereKategorie: Only needed if the ad also promotes loans or jobs.
hilfe.angezeigterLink: Short address shown in the ad instead of the full URL. Optional.
hilfe.anzeigeName: Only visible internally. The identifier (e.g. werbemittel3_lang) helps to match leads.
hilfe.attribution: How long after a click, engagement (engage-through) or view a conversion counts for the ad. Since March 2026 a click only counts link clicks.
hilfe.ausgabenlimits: Ad set spending limits: Meta spends at least or at most this much here (since 2025 as an average, not a hard cap).
hilfe.beschreibung: Small line below the headline, only visible in some placements. Optional.
hilfe.bid: Highest volume gets as many results as possible from the budget. Cost per result goal and bid cap need many conversions per week.
hilfe.bidAmount: Cost per result goal: target average cost per result. Bid cap: maximum bid per auction.
hilfe.blocklisten: IDs of block lists from Business Manager, separated by commas. No ads appear on these sites and apps.
hilfe.budgetArt: Daily budget: average per day, up to 75 % more on good days. Lifetime budget: fixed amount until the end date.
hilfe.budgetplanung: Temporarily raise the daily budget for high-demand days (at least 3 hours, at most 8 times). Afterwards the normal budget applies again.
hilfe.cboAus: Off (recommended): each ad set has its own budget, as in Plan B.
hilfe.conversion: Where the conversion happens and what Meta optimizes for. For HP: website and the event "Schedule" (appointment booked) in the HP pixel.
hilfe.customConversion: Instead of a standard event, a custom conversion (e.g. a specific thank-you page).
hilfe.destination: Website: appointment via the landing page. Instant form: contact details directly in Facebook or Instagram.
hilfe.ende: Empty (recommended): runs without an end date.
hilfe.event: "Schedule" means: appointment booked. Meta optimizes delivery for it.
hilfe.geraete: Nothing ticked means: all devices. For instant forms no desktop together with Instagram.
hilfe.goal: What Meta aligns delivery to. For website appointments: maximize number of conversions.
hilfe.gruppeName: Only visible internally. Good: audience and landing page, e.g. "Kalt · Lang".
hilfe.inventar: Expanded gives the most reach, Limited avoids sensitive content the most.
hilfe.kategorie: Real estate ads must run as housing at Meta. Then only broad audiences are allowed.
hilfe.laufzeitbudget: Fixed amount until the end date of the campaign.
hilfe.markensicherheit: Where ads should not appear next to third-party content (Reels, Audience Network). Stricter account settings always apply.
hilfe.name: Only visible internally, customers do not see it. Good: goal, audience and month.
hilfe.objective: The objective decides what Meta optimizes for. For appointment requests via website or instant form it is "Leads".
hilfe.ortTyp: Both on (recommended): people who live there or were there recently.
hilfe.os: Only people with this mobile operating system. Not needed for HP (recommended: all).
hilfe.seite: The Facebook Page that runs the instant form or messages.
hilfe.spendCap: Optional. Meta pauses the campaign once this much has been spent in total ($100 to $100,000).
hilfe.status: Active: Meta delivers and costs occur. Paused: no delivery, all settings stay.
hilfe.tagesbudget: Average per day. Increases above 20 % can restart the learning phase.
hilfe.ueberschrift: Short and specific, at most 40 characters (HP rule).
hilfe.url: The page where the appointment is booked. The system appends UTM parameters itself.
hilfe.wlan: Mainly for large videos. Strongly limits reach.
hilfe.zeitplan: Deliver only on certain days and times, full hours, at least one hour. Usually not needed for appointment leads.
hilfe.zeitplanKampagne: Leave empty (recommended): runs from activation without an end date, the budgets control spending.
hilfe.ziel: Where the click leads and what the button says. HP: landing page or /termin with "Book now".
hilfe.zielgruppe: Where the ads run and for whom. Under housing only locations, languages, interests and custom audiences.

masse.abgelehntAnzeigeEnde: Ads have no end date of their own.
masse.abgelehntGrenze: The new daily budget would be outside the limits.
masse.abgelehntHilfe: {{n}} items will be rejected completely, their status and name stay unchanged too. Better edit them separately.
masse.abgelehntKeinTagesbudget: No daily budget of its own (lifetime budget or budget at campaign level).
masse.abgelehntWarnung: Meta rejects {{n}} items completely: their status and name do not change either.
masse.aktivHinweis: Activating starts delivery immediately. The server checks the guardrail (sum of all active daily budgets) for all items together and refuses if the limit would be exceeded.
masse.aktivWarnung: {{n}} items become active: Meta delivers immediately, costs occur. The guardrail is checked for all together.
masse.bleibtGanz: Status and name then stay unchanged as well.
masse.budgetHilfeBetrag: Only works for items with their own daily budget. Meta allows budget changes at most 4 times per hour per item.
masse.budgetHilfeProzent: Changes each item’s own budget, including a lifetime budget. Meta allows budget changes at most 4 times per hour per item.
masse.endeHilfe: For campaigns the campaign end date, for ad sets their own. Ads have no end date.
masse.fehlgeschlagen: Nothing changed. Details in the dialog.
masse.laufzeitOderAbgelehnt: No daily budget of its own: a lifetime budget changes by the same percentage, without a budget of its own the whole item is rejected.
masse.lernWarnung: For {{n}} items the budget changes by more than 20 %: the learning phase may restart.
masse.name: Name suffix
masse.nameHilfe: Appended to the end of the name, with a space before it.
masse.prozentFehlt: Please enter a change in percent, e.g. 10 or -20.
masse.teilweise: {{n}} changed, {{f}} failed. Details in the dialog.
masse.unsicherHilfe: {{n}} without their own daily budget: a lifetime budget changes too, without a budget of their own the item is rejected completely.

bearbeiten.neuLadenText: Your changes that have not been applied yet will be lost. Nothing changes at Meta.
bearbeiten.nichtGespeichert: The draft could not be saved. Please check the connection and try again.

bearbeiten.panelUnbekannt: The comparison with the state at Meta comes when reviewing.

plan.bestehend: Already scheduled at Meta: cannot be changed or removed here. New periods can be added.
plan.zuHoch: At most 8 times the daily budget.

sperre.ad_page: The Facebook Page of an ad is fixed after creation.
sperre.beitrag: This ad uses an existing post; texts and media cannot be changed here.
sperre.budget_art: Daily and lifetime budget cannot be swapped after creation.
sperre.budget_level: Switching between campaign and ad set budget is not possible afterwards.
sperre.budget_sharing: Ad set budget sharing can only be turned off while running, not turned on.
sperre.buying_type: The buying type is fixed after creation.
sperre.custom_conversion: The ad set optimizes for a custom conversion, which stays fixed.
sperre.destination: Meta no longer allows changing the conversion location after creation.
sperre.objective: Meta sets the campaign objective at creation.
sperre.optimization_goal: Meta no longer allows changing the performance goal after delivery has started.
sperre.page_id: The page of the conversion goal is fixed after creation.
sperre.pixel: Dataset and conversion event can only be changed for website conversions.
sperre.roas: The bid strategy "ROAS goal" cannot be switched after creation.
sperre.special_ad_categories: Meta no longer allows changing the special ad category after creation.
sperre.standard: No longer changeable at Meta after creation.

bearbeiten.sucheNichts: No setting "{{q}}" in this form. Choose another level in the structure.

tausch.ersetzenText: Ad ID and reporting history stay, Meta reviews the ad again. Old and new numbers mix, reactions on the old post do not carry over.
tausch.geaendert: The creative has changed: a new creative is created at Meta.
tausch.hilfe: Applies as soon as you change texts, media, link, button or identity. Name and status do not change the creative.
tausch.lernphase: In both cases the learning phase of the ad set restarts (about 50 results per week needed).
tausch.neu: New ad, pause the old one
tausch.neuText: The new ad starts without history, the old one is paused (not deleted). Numbers stay cleanly separated per creative, which is also how the quality autopilot calculates.

bearbeiten.wiederverwendet: Open changes from before have been loaded again. "Reload" fetches the fresh state from Meta.

wohnen.detail: Behaviors, job titles, employers, detailed exclusions
wohnen.umkreisGrund: At least 15 km, around cities at least 17 km.

zeitplan.ende: The end must be after the start (at least 1 hour).
zeitplan.immer: Without time windows the ads run around the clock (recommended).

aenderung.fest: Meta does not allow changes to a form after it is created, only copies.
aenderung.lernphase: Does not restart. Only when you use the form in an ad (new ad or swap) does the ad set's learning phase restart.
aenderung.neu: New instant form "{{name}}" on the Facebook Page {{seite}}
aenderung.nichtsSonst: No ad changes. Leads from the form flow into the CRM as before.

formulare.ausKatalog: Preliminary list from the campaign assistant's catalog: leads and form type are missing until the new server function is live.
formulare.bedingung: Condition: only show if an earlier answer matches
formulare.bedingungGesperrt: Meta does not create conditional logic via the API. Add it after creation in Ads Manager under Questions.
formulare.buttonHilfe: With a button to the booking page, some leads book right away.
formulare.buttonLinkHilfe: With utm_source=meta a booking via the button counts as a Meta lead (META badge in the CRM, Conversions API).
formulare.datenschutzHilfe: Required by Meta. Shown below the questions.
formulare.einwAn: Ask for consent to be contacted
formulare.einwHilfe: Checkboxes are never pre-ticked. Required boxes must be ticked.
formulare.festText: Meta does not allow changes to existing instant forms. "Edit as copy" turns it into a new form. Archiving or deleting is deliberately not offered here.
formulare.festTitel: Created at Meta, cannot be changed
formulare.fragenTitelHilfe: Leave empty for Meta's default ("Contact information").
formulare.fragenUntertitel: Meta prefills contact fields. Custom questions separate serious leads from curious ones.
formulare.introHilfe: First screen: says what it is about and what happens next.
formulare.introStilHilfe: Bullet points read faster on a phone than a paragraph.
formulare.introTitelHilfe: Clear from the first second: real estate in Cyprus, EU.
formulare.kopierenGleich: The original and all ads stay unchanged.
formulare.kopierenNeu: New instant form as a copy of "{{name}}"
formulare.ladeFehler: Instant forms could not be loaded
formulare.leadsCrm: Leads from instant forms flow into the CRM automatically as before (sync every 15 minutes).
formulare.leerText: The first form starts with the Happy Property default: higher intent, capital question, button to book an appointment.
formulare.nameHilfe: Only visible internally, e.g. when picking a form in the assistant.
formulare.neuFrageText: This browser still holds the started draft "{{name}}". A new form replaces it. To keep working on it, choose "Continue draft" instead.
formulare.organischHilfe: Hides the form from people who did not see an ad (organic leads, often spam).

pruef.buttonText: Button text on the completion page
pruef.doppelt: Question {{nr}} appears twice in the form
pruef.einwilligung: Consent: at least one checkbox with text
pruef.keinKontakt: Without email or phone number nobody can reach the lead.
pruef.schluesselZeichen: Question {{nr}}: key only from a-z, 0-9 and _
pruef.sms: SMS verification needs the phone number question
pruef.tracking: Tracking parameter: name only letters, digits and _

strategie.title: Your investment roadmap
strategie.empty: This roadmap does not contain any apartments yet.
strategie.assumptions: Appreciation {{g}} % p.a., rent growth {{r}} % p.a., financing as an annuity loan at {{i}} % over {{y}} years, tax residence Germany ({{d}} % marginal rate). For short-term letting the VAT refund after 24 months is included. During construction, instalments already paid are shown as committed capital - that money sits in the property, it is not lost.
strategie.disclaimer: This overview is an example calculation based on the assumptions above and does not replace tax or investment advice. You received the detailed individual calculations for the apartments separately.
strategie.periodNote: Period considered: 10 years from the handover of the first apartment (until {{to}}).
strategie.chartWorthSub: Your net worth grows while the loan is being repaid.
strategie.chartCfSub: What remains after interest, principal, management and taxes.
strategie.bridgeText: The instalments temporarily exceed your equity - by {{peak}} at peak. That amount is bridge-financed until handover; the interest is included in the table (interest column) and at handover the actual loan replaces the bridge.
strategie.assumptions2: Appreciation {{g}} % p.a., rent growth {{r}} % p.a., financing as an annuity loan at {{i}} % over {{y}} years. For short-term letting the VAT refund after 24 months is included.
strategie.taxFirma: Held through a Cypriot company: {{k}} % corporate tax on the profit after management, interest and depreciation (3 % building, 10 % furniture), losses carried forward 5 years. {{d}} % has been applied to the distribution.
strategie.taxCyPrivat: Held privately, tax residence Cyprus: first €22,000 tax free, then 20 to 35 %, after a 20 % flat deduction on the rent, 3 % building depreciation, 10 % on furniture and the loan interest{{gesy}}.
strategie.taxDePrivat: Held privately, tax residence Germany: Cyprus taxes first, Germany recalculates at a {{d}} % marginal rate and credits the Cypriot tax.
strategie.exNet: What is left after the sale
strategie.exNote: The sale is a model assumption. Sale price, costs and taxes may differ. The VAT refunded for short-term letting must be partly repaid within the first ten years; that is included above.
strategie.tlReady: Handover {{d}}: rent, loan and taxes start here
strategie.tlExitSub: The loan is repaid, the rest flows back to you.
strategie.scIntro: Nobody knows the market of the coming years. That is why the same strategy is shown three times here: with the planned assumptions, with more cautious ones and with more favourable ones.
strategie.risk1: The actual appreciation of the properties
strategie.riskNote: The calculation is a scenario simulation and not a guarantee of future development.
strategie.taxCyPrivat2: Held privately, tax residence Cyprus: first €22,000 tax free, then 20 to 35 %. Running costs, 3 % building depreciation, 10 % on furniture and the loan interest are deducted{{extra}}.
strategie.taxCySi: and social insurance of 16.6 % as a self-employed landlord
strategie.s2sub: The value of the properties grows while the loan is repaid. What lies in between belongs to you.
strategie.c1sub: Equity in the properties is value minus loan. Net worth additionally counts liquidity and the capital tied up during construction.
strategie.s3sub: Each step is a further purchase funded by appreciation and repayment.
strategie.s4: How your capital works more than once
strategie.s4sub: When the value of an apartment rises while the loan falls, room for further financing appears. That capital flows into property again.
strategie.hRecycle: Shows how often capital from refinancing and sales is used again for property purchases in the model.
strategie.recycleText: That is how often your originally invested capital was used again for further investments in the model.
strategie.c3: Where the capital comes from and where it goes
strategie.c3sub: Green are inflows from refinancing and sales, orange is the capital that goes into a purchase.
strategie.oppTitle: {{y}}: a further investment would be possible on paper
strategie.oppModel: Purchase price of the next apartment in the model
strategie.oppNote: Possible on paper under the assumptions chosen. The bank decides on the actual financing.
strategie.s5: What the portfolio produces year by year
strategie.s5sub: Positive means the rents carry the instalment, the costs and the taxes. Negative means you top it up that year.
strategie.c5sub: The dashed line is the reserve that should never be touched in the model.
strategie.liqText: Between {{from}} and {{to}} the model falls below the intended reserve, at its lowest point {{low}}. During that time additional equity would be needed, or a further purchase would have to come later.
strategie.s6sub: The further the loan is repaid and the higher the value, the more room appears for further financing.
strategie.hLtv: Ratio of loan to the value of the properties.
strategie.s9sub: Nobody knows the market of the coming years. The same strategy, calculated three times: with the planned assumptions, with more cautious ones and with more favourable ones.
strategie.sensNote: Assumed appreciation per year, below it the number of apartments and the net worth at the end.
strategie.s10: What is left after the sale
strategie.exNote2: The sale is a model assumption. Sale price, costs and taxes may differ. The VAT refunded for short-term letting has to be partly repaid within the first ten years; that is included in the costs.
strategie.assumptions3: Appreciation {{g}} % per year, rent growth {{r}} % per year, financing as an annuity loan at {{i}} % over {{y}} years.
strategie.assumptionsRe: For refinancing a maximum loan to value of {{l}} % of the property value is assumed, with a minimum liquidity of {{c}}.
strategie.taxFirma2: Held through a Cypriot company: {{k}} % corporate tax, {{d}} % applied to the distribution.
strategie.taxCy3: Held privately, tax residence Cyprus: first €22,000 tax free, then 20 to 35 %, after deducting running costs, 3 % building depreciation, 10 % on furniture and the loan interest.
strategie.taxDe3: Held privately, tax residence Germany: Cyprus taxes first, Germany recalculates at {{d}} % and credits the Cypriot tax.
strategie.disc1: The results shown are model calculations based on the assumptions chosen. Appreciation, rental income, financing conditions, bank valuation, refinancing options and sale prices in particular may differ in reality.
strategie.disc2: A refinancing shown here is not a commitment by any bank. The actual financing depends among other things on income, existing obligations, creditworthiness, property valuation and the lender's own policies.
strategie.disc3: Tax calculations serve the model and do not replace individual tax advice.
strategie.recycleText2: That is how often your originally invested capital was used again for further properties in the model. It is not a return: the factor says nothing about the profit, only how often the same capital worked again.
strategie.hCap: Additional financing that is possible on paper based on the assumed lending value. The bank makes the actual credit decision.
strategie.xNone: No income tax arises in the modelled period: management, running costs, loan interest and depreciation exceed the rental income in the tax calculation. What remains is the health contribution and, where applicable, the tax on the sale.
strategie.sBalanceSub: Most of it is not in your account but as equity in the apartments.
strategie.exBalance: Why this is not your account balance
strategie.exBalance1: Net worth and liquidity are two different things. The property value minus the loans belongs to you economically, but it is tied up in bricks. Only the liquidity in the last line is available.
strategie.exBalance2: To get at the equity in the apartments you would have to sell or refinance. Both are modelled here, both cost tax or increase the debt.
strategie.exLtv1: Loan to value is the ratio of loan to property value. €600,000 of loan on €1,000,000 of value is 60 percent.
strategie.exLtv2: The model assumes a maximum loan to value of {{l}} percent. That is an assumption for the calculation, not a commitment by any bank. As the loan falls and the value rises, the gap to that limit grows, and exactly that gap is the additional borrowing capacity.
strategie.sCostSub: Not every payment is lost. Repayment, for example, moves from your account into your equity.
strategie.three1t: Cash flow is not wealth building
strategie.three1: A year can cost money and still create wealth: the apartment gains value and the loan falls, while little is left in the account.
strategie.three2: If you repay €20,000 of loan, your liquidity falls by €20,000 and your debt by the same amount. Your equity therefore rises by €20,000. Only the interest is a real cost.
strategie.three3t: Wealth is not your account balance
strategie.three3: Most of your wealth sits in the apartments. Only the liquidity is available. Anyone who wants at it has to sell or refinance.
strategie.payShift: Construction instalments are counted back from the handover date. They fall due when the respective construction stage is finished and move if construction is faster or slower.
strategie.pOpenSale: open instalments, from the sale proceeds
strategie.credSubRent: Every purchase instalment according to the developers' payment plans. Your equity covers the instalments in date order, across all units. After that, the rent contributes. Only what is still missing is financed by the bank.
strategie.credCashReserved: Units bought in cash have their equity reserved.
strategie.credNoneSurplus: no loan, rent and VAT suffice
strategie.vatReturned: The VAT refund for {{name}} ({{amount}}, {{date}}) goes back to you and is not used for purchase instalments.
strategie.credSubSurplus: Every purchase instalment according to the developers' payment plans. Your equity covers the instalments in date order, across all units. After that, rent and the VAT refund contribute. Only what is still missing is financed by the bank.
strategie.credBridgeNote2: Until a loan's monthly payment starts, you draw the loan in stages as the instalments fall due. Only interest is charged on it, which is included in the cash flow. From the month shown, the regular monthly payment applies.
strategie.credSub: Every purchase instalment according to the developers' payment plans. Your equity covers the instalments in date order, across all units. From the point where it is used up, you need a loan.
strategie.credLoans: These become the following bank loans
strategie.timelineSub: Every entry is an event from the calculation, none of it is invented.
strategie.buyerSingle: The model calculation takes into account the personal tax-free basic amount of €22,000 per year and a lifetime allowance of €30,000 on sale. Both apply per person and are not multiplied per apartment.
strategie.buyerCouple: The strategy is implemented jointly by two people. Cyprus assesses each person separately, so the model calculation takes into account the personal tax-free basic amounts of both people, together €44,000 per year and €60,000 lifetime on sale. These amounts apply per person and are not multiplied per apartment.
strategie.assumptionsPrice: Later purchases are not calculated at today's price: the model property's purchase price rises by {{g}} % per year, the rent only with rent growth. The initial yield of later purchases is therefore lower than today.
